n = 23
# Edge variables
edges = {}
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        edges[(i,j)] = z3.Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}")

# Degree constraints
s = z3.Solver()
for i in range(n):
    deg = z3.Sum([z3.If(edges[(min(i,j), max(i,j))], 1, 0) for j in range(n) if j != i])
    s.add(deg >= 4)
    s.add(deg <= 5)

# No triangles
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        for k in range(j+1, n):

# Check satisfiability
print("Checking...")
res = s.check()
print("Result:", res)
if res == z3.sat:
    m = s.model()
    sol_edges = []
    for (i,j), v in edges.items():
        if z3.is_true(m[v]):
            sol_edges.append((i,j))
    print("Edges:", sol_edges)

    # Check degrees
    degs = [0]*n
    for (i,j) in sol_edges:

        degs[j] += 1
    print("Degrees:", degs)

                if b <= a: continue
                for c in adj[b]:
                    if c == a: continue
                    for d in adj[c]:
                        if d == a or d == b: continue
                        for ee in adj[d]:
                            if ee == a or ee == b or ee == c: continue
                            if a in adj[ee]:
                                # Found 5-cycle a-b-c-d-ee-a
                                print(f"  Found 5-cycle: {a}-{b}-{c}-{d}-{ee}-{a}")
                                s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(edge(a,b), edge(b,c), edge(c,d), edge(d,ee), edge(ee,a))))
                                found = True
                                break
        if not found:
            print("No 5-cycle found! Solution valid.")
            print("Edges:", sol_edges)
            print("Number of edges:", len(sol_edges))
            degs = [len(adj[i]) for i in range(n)]
            print("Degrees:", degs)
            print("Min/Max:", min(degs), max(degs))
            break
        
        print(f"  Checking satisfiability again...")
        res = s.check()
        if res != z3.sat:
            print("UNSAT!")
            break
